class.name: SignalAspect
class.brief_description: One aspect of a [SignalHeadKind]: what each light does when the signal head shows it.
class.description: One aspect of a [SignalHeadKind]: what each light does when the signal head shows it, light 0 first. A light past the list, or one set to [constant LIGHT_KEEP], is left as it is. Blink times missing from their lists are the kind's.

members.member: What each light does, a [enum LightCommand] per light, light 0 first.
How long each blinking light stays dark [s], light 0 first; the kind's [member SignalHeadKind.blink_off_time] where missing.
How long each blinking light stays lit [s], light 0 first; the kind's [member SignalHeadKind.blink_on_time] where missing.
Where in its cycle each blinking light starts [s], light 0 first.

constants.constant: The light is left as it is.
